title: Compare private historical prompt tests
boundary: Read-only history comparison: does not execute a model, select, promote or apply a revision. Results are not used for automatic cost routing.
evidence: Uses the complete fixed dataset and saved historical configuration. This is a read snapshot, not a reproduction of complete model context. No private comparison is saved in this browser.
testHelp: Enter one test per revision per dataset case, separated by spaces, commas or newlines. No latest-success selection or automatic execution. Missing cases block review.
failed: Comparison could not be verified or access expired. Check permissions and historical IDs, then compare again.
reviewable: Evidence is eligible for human review only — not publication approval.
blocked: Review blocked — quality scores alone are not a pass.
costBoundary: Costs are the ledger snapshot read now, not a complete execution-cost guarantee. Unknown is never zero; known subtotal excludes unknown cases.
blockerIncompleteEvidence: Historical evidence is incomplete or inconsistent.
blockerQualityRegressed: Candidate quality is lower than the baseline.
blockerMissingRun: No explicit historical test was supplied for this case.
blockerRunNotSucceeded: This historical test did not finish successfully.
blockerUnsupportedOutputFormat: The recorded output is not supported for exact-text scoring.
blockerInputSnapshotMismatch: The input snapshot differs from the fixed dataset.
blockerOutputMissing: The recorded text output is missing.
blockerExecutionContextUnknown: The historical execution context is unknown.
blockerExecutionContextMismatch: The historical execution contexts do not match.
